name: Querétaro

queries.query: Querétaro mapa catastral parcelas IDECATQ predios urbanos catastro municipal servicio WMS
queries.result: El Instituto Registral y Catastral estatal publica IDECATQ. El selector identifica Querétaro como municipio 14 y su capa urbana M14_PA aparece en el catálogo WMS con extensión que cubre el punto WUP. El servicio WFS responde que está deshabilitado. La herramienta Identify está ligada a una cédula catastral registral con campos personales y valuatorios; no se solicitó información de predios.

queries.query: Querétaro official municipal cadastral map urban parcel WMS feature service
queries.result: The state cadastral institute publishes a public map with a Querétaro urban parcel layer (M14_PA). WMS capabilities provide map metadata and display coverage only. WFS is disabled, while the identify workflow links a selected cadastral key to an owner/address/value cédula. No feature query or geometry was requested.

portals.observation: Official IDECATQ public viewer; municipality selector identifies Querétaro as code 14 and the client configures urban parcel layer M14_PA.
Official state cadastral institution lists cadastral-record and cartography services.

Official municipality planning map page and land-use lookup.
Municipal instrument assigns local cadastral-registrar functions over parcels in the municipality.

requests.observation: IDECATQ viewer shell; municipality selector contains QUERÉTARO code 14. Client JavaScript configures public WMS and urban parcel layer M14_PA.

WMS Capabilities declares queryable M14_PA layer in EPSG:32614 and CRS:84, extent [-100.5895544,20.5377089,-100.3258632,20.9241908]. WUP point falls inside the bounding extent only; no parcel hit was tested.
OGC exception report states “Service WFS is disabled”; no vector feature request was made.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: No public, anonymous full-polygon response with privacy-safe selected attributes was retrieved or retained.

source.name: Querétaro city cadastral source review
source.operator: Instituto Registral y Catastral del Estado de Querétaro (IRCQ), Government of Querétaro; municipal Dirección de Catastro
source.format: Official public cadastral map/registry and municipal land records; no safe full-vector API verified
source.access: Public source and layer-metadata review only; no account login, owner search, address search, cadastral-key search, or feature identify query used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: State map metadata lists Querétaro urban parcel layer M14_PA whose rectangular extent contains the WUP point; extent is not a parcel containment result.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public registry/map activity is confirmed, but anonymous privacy-safe full polygon retrieval is not verified.

registryBasis: The state Instituto Registral y Catastral operates IDECATQ with Querétaro municipal urban-parcel layer M14_PA; the municipal Dirección de Catastro administers local cadastral records. The WMS is public, but WFS is explicitly disabled. Public Identify links to cadastral cédula fields including owner, address and valuation; no feature query was made. The informational disclaimer is not the access limitation.
technicalBlocker: Public WMS map metadata confirms layer M14_PA but does not return full polygon geometry. The WFS endpoint explicitly reports “Service WFS is disabled”; the WMS Identify route can expose owner, address and value attributes, so it was not queried.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a documented anonymous feature route can return full geometry with only safe native parcel identifiers is unresolved; the WUP point is not matched to any parcel.
nextStep: If further research is warranted, use a documented public feature service only after confirming a property-safe field projection; never use identify/cédula/search functions that expose owner, address or tax data.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. No owner/address/property value or account data retained; no parcel-level lookup or geometry was performed.
